name: Mosaic Plot
description: Visualises the joint distribution of two categorical variables — column widths show the marginal frequency, segment heights show the conditional shares.
whenToUse: Compare how two categorical variables combine: column widths show the share of each x category, segment heights the share of each group within it.
placeholderPickBoth: Pick two categorical columns (X and G). Both are required — without them the mosaic plot is undefined.
